latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — quickly edit smartphone videos online with no APK download required.

- Upload and edit video clips (up to 500MB) directly in your browser.
- Smart cloud backend: just describe your edits, and get a 1080p MP4 in 1-2 minutes.
- Automatic token and session setup; 100 free credits, no registration needed.
- Supports workflows for cutting, transitions, adding music/text, and fast social-ready exports.
- Full support for major video and audio formats; handles multiple tracks and iterative edits.
- Simple commands for export, credits check, and status, mapped to intuitive actions.
